predeclared.L_rule: P3b joint L-selection on this bank (not blind-pin 40)
predeclared.gate: point alpha_hat <= 5% both + coverage <=5% both at selected L

block_A3_selection.rule_block: smallest L≥H with studentized no-search P(LCB>0)≤α both cadences
block_A3_selection.rule_A3: smallest n_legs_floor where in-domain coverage ≤α both cadences

k_selection.rule: smallest k with net-LCB power≥0.5 at edge=max(k·RT,10)

stop_condition.gate_rule: PASS iff point alpha_hat<=5% both cadences AND no-search coverage<=5% both at selected L; Wilson/SE disclosure only
escalation_if_stop: 1 calendar/regime-scaled purge (recommend; not implemented in P3c)
stop_condition.note: If STOP: do not freeze, do not soften α, do not implement escalation in P3c — recommend rung 1. If PASS: recommend P4 (operator mandate still required).
